revise_description: Due to a new logistics policy, winter purchases are limited by cash while later purchases are inventory-backed. Introduce quarter-specific purchase caps using new param max_purchase_10k_m3[q], add end-of-autumn safety inventory with terminal inventory value, and apply over_purchase_penalty_cost_per_10k_m3 to inventory above safety_inventory_level_10k_m3.
